FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Home Comfort Furniture & Installation is a retail furniture store focused on providing high-quality furniture and professional installation services to residential customers. Our operations include offering a wide selection of contemporary and classic furniture styles, such as sofas, dining sets, and bedroom furniture. We pride ourselves on our knowledgeable in-store staff who assist customers in making informed purchasing decisions and provide guidance throughout the shopping experience. Additionally, we have a dedicated team of trained installation professionals employed by our company, ensuring that all installations are completed safely and efficiently. We maintain a clean and organized showroom environment of less than 10,000 sq ft, emphasizing customer comfort and accessibility. Our inventory is securely stored in monitored facilities that comply with local safety regulations to prevent any potential risks related to fire or theft. Furthermore, we continuously strive to improve customer satisfaction by having a clear return and warranty policy in place.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any on-site woodworking, manufacturing, or refinishing operations and confirms that all installation subcontractors provide proof of insurance and training. Additionally, the business does not offer furniture rental or leasing services and confirms that it does not sell or install medical, mobility, or playground equipment.
